_instructions: Generic voucher field aliases and period patterns. No organization names, prices, exchange rates or factor values are stored here; all numeric conversion constants are supplied at run time through hints.

manual_reasons.no_text_layer: PDF has no extractable text layer; manual entry or visual reading required
manual_reasons.image_voucher: Image voucher; the agent may supply a visual candidate, human sign-off is mandatory
manual_reasons.amount_only: Only a monetary amount was found; physical quantity needs a runtime price table or manual entry
manual_reasons.missing_unit: Unit is absent or ambiguous; resolve before calculation
manual_reasons.template_year: Template year in the voucher differs from the configured reporting year; verify
manual_reasons.cross_month: Billing period crosses a natural month boundary; verify the consumption period
manual_reasons.broken_formula: Spreadsheet total formula is empty or suspicious; recompute from monthly columns
manual_reasons.issue_date_only: Only the invoice issue date is available; it is not the consumption period
